plan.notes: Iowa State University 2026-2027 catalog, Mechanical Engineering B.S. official Four Year Plan ('Four Year Plan' tab). Catalog total: 129 credits; semester sums match exactly. ENGR 1010 Engineering Orientation and ME 2020 Mechanical Engineering - Professional Planning are 0-credit required courses (required_zero; catalog lists them as arranged). CE 2710 (1 cr) and CE 2720 (2 cr) are the two halves of the statics requirement; both carry the catalog's combined title 'Engineering Foundations of Statics and Applied Engineering Statics' (3 cr total). General Education Electives (15 cr) comprise one economics course (ECON 1010/1020), Social Science, Humanities (6 cr), and Humanities or Social Science. The Communication Requirement slot is one of ENGL 3020, 3090, 3140, or SPCM 2120. Technical Elective slots are 15 credits of approved technical electives. Capstone Design is one of ME 4150 Mechanical Systems Design or ME 4420 Heating and Air Conditioning Design.
